notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Starting planet selection

You can now start your game from a planet you've previously reached, skipping earlier planets and possible rewards. The appropriate weapons are unlocked. You still get one equipment from your previous run.

Not available in Expert mode



Simulation test level

Learn to use your weapons and equipment in a risk-free simulation, launched from within the ship/shop menu. You can even try out newly bought equipment and sell them back at the same price after the test if you don't like it. Equipment resale value still drops to half after playing a real level.



Localization

Added 10 languages: Finnish, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese (Simplified), Korean



Equipment rebalancing

BFR-1000 ammo 2 -> 3

Slag Gun ammo 8 -> 10

Wormhole Generator cooldown 30s -> 25s



Brightness setting for enemy dying flashing effect

Fixed bugs with setting up 2-player controls

Fixed a rare bug with explosions

Minor visual changes

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Equipment Stacking

Combine Equipment of the same type to create a more powerful version of it, increasing ammo capacity, decreasing cooldown or boosting other capabilities.

Mouse Controls

Mouse Movement
Controls can be bound to mouse buttons and scroll wheel

[strike]Gamepad Rumble[/strike]

[strike]Rumble strength adjustable in options[/strike]
Gamepad rumble is not working at the moment, sorry for the inconvenience

Added images to illustrate tips in the loading screen
In-level player 2 UI recolored as yellow to easily differentiate players
Small visual improvements and bugfixes

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Added Casual Difficulty

Same as Easy except enemy health is reduced to 50% and you start with a full loadout of equipment instead of selecting an equipment from the previous run
Can't carry over equipment from Casual Difficulty to other difficulty modes
In-game effects of difficulty selection are now listed more comprehensively
New weapon intros
3rd weapon now unlocks one level earlier
Prevent generating identical level bonuses and offering them simultaneously when possible
Adjusting music volume during a level plays a preview of music


UI:

 Added a level progress bar to the top left of the screen
 Added Fighter and Carrier status screens to fill out left side of screen in single player
Added new settings:

Controls:

Always fire
Fire with weapon button and supercharge button
Adjustable deadzones for analog stick for player movement in game

Menu deadzones are not adjustable, but they are large
Display:

Screen shake multiplier adjustable between 0.0 - 2.0
Brightness gamma slider
Accessibility:

Lock cursor option

Locked cursor during a level has been the default, you can now unlock the cursor for use with external accessibility tools
Background haze

Add haze to level backgrounds, making game objects easier to see

Bug fixes:

Fixed unresponsive analog stick in level select screen
Optimized spawning large drone star formations
Fixed Seeker Missiles sometimes not prioritizing Darts correctly
Fixed long delay before shooting when switching from gatling fusion gun to base fusion gun
Other minor fixes

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
- Shops now offer more affordable equipment.
- Changed primary weapon descriptions to clarify their role and function.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
- Fixed a menu navigation bug when selecting equipment from previous run.
- Lowered some difficulty curves: starting difficulty unchanged, end of run difficulty lowered:
-- Easy 3 -> 2.5
-- Normal 4.4 -> 3.9
-- Hard 5.3 -> 5
- Easy difficulty: carrier has 1s immunity after taking damage.
